title: EVERAFTER: Feature Film
description:
When a terminally ill patient arrives at the revolutionary anti-aging clinic EverAfter, its

billionaire founder and CEO, Zachary Phillips, is forced to push the limits of his research.

But as the procedures involved become more extreme, patient and doctor begin to

question each other’s motives and the true nature of their relationship is revealed.


A psychological thriller / horror, in the vein of EX MACHINA, MIDSOMMAR and

HEREDITARY – EVERAFTER is a gripping take on obsession, desire, control and power -

a horrific satire on society’s obsession with self-image, wellness and legacy, and the

advantageous nature of those who seek to exploit it. The film is currently in the final

stages of development and has TIM ROTH attached to star as the lead.
